title: WB-FF-DS registry: shared definitions
description: Identifiers and value shapes shared by every registry file. These IDs are names, never fetched.

month.description: A year, or a year and month: YYYY or YYYY-MM.

text.description: Plain text with no leading or trailing whitespace.

slug.description: A lowercase name: letters, digits and hyphens.

sourceId.description: S- judged by or specification, R- learn from, U- reuse input. Example: S-WCAG-1.4.10.

ruleId.description: Foundation prefix, a hyphen, the group letter and a number. Example: L-T1.

decisionId.description: DEC- and three digits. Example: DEC-001.

consumer.description: Who uses a rule. layout: the layout agent. a11y: the accessibility reviewer. rtl: the RTL and i18n reviewer. ci: automated checks. qa: the QA engineer. docs: the documentation writer. platform: the platform engineer.
